dataIntro: Download the full published collection, understand its sources, and help make it better.
coverageNote: Counts describe this curated collection, not the size or completeness of the diaspora. Categories and countries can overlap.
csvNote: CSV includes every status. Arrays are JSON cells; spreadsheet formulas are neutralized with a leading apostrophe. JSON preserves original text.
aboutIntro: A bilingual, community-maintained atlas of mainland Chinese diaspora initiatives and their documented civic cooperation.
scopeText: Primary listings cover independent mainland Chinese diaspora cultural, student, professional, civic, feminist, LGBTQ+, religious, mutual-aid, media, and artistic initiatives abroad or online. Connected institutions enter through evidenced cooperation with a primary initiative; they may include libraries, universities, NGOs, public bodies, funders, or commercial partners. Individuals, purely commercial businesses, and government-operated groups are excluded from the primary directory. Hong Kong-only and Taiwan-only diaspora organizations are outside this release scope.
reviewText: Every published entry needs public evidence, an original summary, and a human review. We do not infer identity or affiliations from names. Unknown activity and unclear affiliation are explicitly labelled. Stale records remain visible; verification older than 180 days is flagged as of the dataset release.
affiliationText: Primary initiatives require evidence of self-organization. Institutional character and relationship characteristics are separate claims. Bonding, bridging, and linking describe evidenced cooperation; they can overlap and are never impact scores. Unknown activity, affiliation, classification, and period remain explicit. Public-source inclusion does not depend on answering our voluntary questionnaire. Listings are not endorsements.
contributeTitle: Leave a little star on the map.
contributeIntro: Know a community we missed? Help this shared constellation grow.
publicWarning: GitHub Issues and Pull Requests are public. Do not include personal details, private invitations, precise meeting places, or sensitive evidence.
addText: Share an organization-owned public link and evidence that it serves mainland Chinese diaspora communities.
correctText: Improve a summary, update a public link, or contribute a missing translation.
removeText: For safety-sensitive corrections or removals, use the private contact. You do not need a GitHub account.
notConfigured: This channel is not configured for public use yet.
privacyTitle: A map of communities, not people.
privacyIntro: We publish public organizations with minimal location information. Your browsing and your position are not a dataset.
privacyData: Organization pins use city centroids. We never publish personal contacts, private venues, attendance information, or member lists. Sources and summaries are reviewed before publication.
privacyLocation: Use my location is optional and requests browser permission only when you activate it. Coordinates stay in temporary atlas memory; they never enter URLs, local storage, exports, analytics, or application logs. Clear them with the control or leave/reload the atlas. No continuous tracking, IP lookup, or reverse geocoding. Browser/OS location providers have their own privacy practices.
privacyTiles: Map tile requests send network/browser information and reveal the approximate viewed area to the tile provider, including after locating yourself. The directory remains usable if imagery fails. No remote fonts, embedded social media, or trackers are used.
privacyRemoval: For a credible safety concern we hide first and investigate privately. Current removal cannot erase Git history, prior downloads, caches, or third-party copies. Sensitive reports must never be posted in public Issues.
coveragePending: The reviewed collection is being prepared. You can explore an explicitly labelled local demo while curation continues.
freshnessNote: Freshness is calculated at the dataset release date.
